# Smart Dairy Hub

> AI-powered dairy management platform for Indian farmers: milk rates, disease detection, veterinarians, cattle and feed marketplace, and government schemes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Smart Dairy Hub tools for dairy farmers.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Buy cattle feed, medicines and dairy supplies.
- [Cattle Market](/cattle-market): Buy and sell cows and buffaloes.
- [Milk Rates](/milk-rates): Milk rates published by dairies and collection centres.
- [Milk Calculator](/milk-calculator): Calculate milk price from FAT and SNF.
- [AI Disease Detection](/disease-detection): Photo-based animal health check (advisory only).
- [Veterinary Doctors](/vet-contacts): Find nearby veterinarians.
- [Government Schemes](/schemes): Dairy subsidies and loans with official links.
- [Help Center](/help): Frequently asked questions.

## Optional

- [About](/about): Our mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [Terms](/terms), [Privacy](/privacy), [Refund](/refund): Policies.
